faqs.question: What is the eligibility to get admission in Guru Nanak Dev Engineering College for UG/PG courses?
faqs.answer:
Guru Nanak Dev Engineering College has below criteria for taking admissions to it's various courses:
Courses Eligibility
M.E./M.Tech Candidates must have passed B.E./ B.Tech. in any Branch of Engineering with atleast 50% (45% in case of candidate belonging to reserved category) marks in aggregate. In case seats haven't been filled under respective categories, admission shall be considered on the basis of Inter-se-merit in the qualifying examination. OR AMIE/ AMIETE/ AMACSE graduates including graduates from other Govt. recognised professional bodies equivalent to AMIE with 55% or above marks in their exams in such body shall be eligible with the condition that the branch adopted at graduation level must be same as the specialisation applied for. All those students who were enrolled with various Profession Bodies/Institutions, which were duly recognised by MHRD with permanent recognition upto 31/05/2013, stand recognized. In addition to above, two years experience after B.Tech. is mandatory.
MCA Candidates who have completed M.Sc. in IT/ CS with mathematics as a course at 10+2, Graduation level or PG level are eligible to apply.
B.E. / B.Tech Candidate must have passed Diploma in engineering or B.Sc. (non-medical) from a recognised university.
B.Arch Candidate who have passed 10+3 Diploma Examination with Mathematics as compulsory subject with at least 50% marks in aggregate from a recognised Institute/ University can also apply. Candidates appearing for 10+3 Diploma with Mathematics in the current year may also provisionally appear for NATA-2023.
MBA/PGDM Candidates must have passed Bachelors Degree of minimum three year duration in any disciplineand must have obtained above mentioned marks (45% marks in case of candidates belonging to reserve category) from the University recognised by the University Grants Commission (UGC). In case seats haven't been filled under respective categories, admission shall be considered on the basis of Inter-se-merit in the qualifying examination.

placements.overview: Established in 1956, Guru Nanak Dev Engineering College is also known as GNDEC is located in Ludhiana, Punjab. The institute offers courses like B.E. / B.Tech, M.E./M.Tech, MBA/PGDM, MCA and B.Arch. These courses are offered in Full Time and Part Time mode. A total of 44 courses offered by the Institute are available across streams such as Engineering, IT & Software, Business & Management Studies and Architecture & Planning. The institute has all the necessary facilities to the students.

reviews_list.batch_info: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2027
reviews_list.review_title: Good college with supportive faculty and fair exams.

review_content.Placements: I am studying B.Tech CSE at Guru Nanak Dev Engineering College, Ludhiana, and this is my honest review of placements. The college provides decent placement opportunities, especially for CSE students. Companies like TCS, Infosys, Wipro, Capgemini, and some startups visit every year. The training and placement cell conducts aptitude classes, mock interviews, and coding sessions, which help during the placement drive. Students who focus on skills like DSA, programming, and communication usually secure good offers. The average package is reasonable for freshers, and a few students get higher packages based on their performance. Overall, placements are good if students stay consistent and prepare well.

reviews_list.batch_info: B.Tech. in Information Technology - Batch of 2028
reviews_list.review_title: I am satisfied with the hostel faculty.

review_content.Placements: Nearly 85% of the B.Tech IT batch at GNDEC were placed in this course. The highest package offered was 10-11 LPA, the lowest was 3.5-4.5 LPA, and the average was 4.75-6 LPA. Top recruiting companies are Amazon, IBM, Just Dial, Accenture, Samsung, Infosys, etc. More than 70 students got internships.
review_content.Infrastructure: The facilities and infrastructure available for my course/department are quite good. We have access to high-speed Wi-Fi throughout the campus, which is very helpful for programmming. In hostel, the quality of facilities is satisfactory. Rooms are of a decent size with proper lighting and furniture.

reviews_list.batch_info: B.Tech. in Electronics and Communication Engineering - Batch of 2024
reviews_list.review_title: I am satisfied with the college's infrastructure and faculty.

review_content.Placements: In our session, 80% of students got placement in local as well as MNCs. The highest package was 8 LPA, and the lowest is around 4.5 LPA. Many other students got internships from recruiting companies. The placement cell is very active in handling all these activities.
review_content.Infrastructure: Our college has very good infrastructure with well-equipped labs having various software and hardware. In every department, there is a departmental library, and a central library, which is common for all departments, is also available. There is a Wi-Fi facility throughout the whole campus.

reviews_list.batch_info: B.Tech. in Civil Engineering - Batch of 2028
reviews_list.review_title: Very good and in our college chances of placement is very high.

review_content.Placements: Nearly 70% of students choose this course. The lowest average package is 20,000 to 2 LPA after this course. We can apply for government jobs. Companies are more than one and at least very good, and roles given by the college are more than one and also interesting.
review_content.Infrastructure: Yes, in our college, Wi-Fi facilities and the library are very good, with AC labs and classrooms. The quality of the mess is also good, but the canteen is not very good. Sports and games are at the state level, and there is also a dispensary for medical problems. Medicine is also free.

reviews_list.batch_info: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2027
reviews_list.review_title: Really nice faculty and atmosphere.

review_content.Placements: 80% of students in my course were placed, and the average package offered is 6 LPA. Recruiting companies include Infosys, Airtel, etc. Nearly 90% of students got internships in my course. Roles offered include software engineer.
review_content.Infrastructure: The college has good facilities and infrastructure, including well-equipped labs, good classrooms, and a pleasant library environment. Hostel facilities are also good, with good food and 24-hour medical facilities. There are provisions for all kinds of sports and games.

reviews_list.batch_info: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2028
reviews_list.review_title: I am quite satisfied because of facility campus and environment of college etc.

review_content.Placements: Placement opportunities depend on the potential of the students. In the past, there was only one student in 2018 or 2019 who secured a package above 50 LPA. The average package for the current year, 2024, is 6 LPA, offered by Argusoft company in the CSE branch. Teachers assist students by conducting career counseling sessions.
review_content.Infrastructure: The infrastructure is quite decent. The hostel is well-furnished and clean. The mess food is tasty, healthy, and offers a nice menu. Hostel Wi-Fi has a good range, but campus Wi-Fi is comparatively slower. Overall, campus buildings are well-maintained, seating areas are good, and classrooms are suitable for learning.

Mess food is average but manageable, and cleanliness is maintained re...

reviews.review_heading: I am satisfied with the hostel faculty.
reviews.review_text:
The facilities and infrastructure available for my course/department are quite good. We have access to high-speed Wi-Fi throughout the campus, which is very helpful for programmming. 
In hostel, the quality of facilities is satisfactory. Rooms are of a decent size with proper lighting and furniture.

reviews.review_heading: I am satisfied with the college's infrastructure and faculty.
reviews.review_text: Our college has very good infrastructure with well-equipped labs having various software and hardware. In every department, there is a departmental library, and a central library, which is common for all departments, is also available. There is a Wi-Fi facility throughout the whole campus.

reviews.review_heading: Very good and in our college chances of placement is very high.
reviews.review_text: Yes, in our college, Wi-Fi facilities and the library are very good, with AC labs and classrooms. The quality of the mess is also good, but the canteen is not very good. Sports and games are at the state level, and there is also a dispensary for medical problems. Medicine is also free.

reviews.review_heading: Really nice faculty and atmosphere.
reviews.review_text: The college has good facilities and infrastructure, including well-equipped labs, good classrooms, and a pleasant library environment. Hostel facilities are also good, with good food and 24-hour medical facilities. There are provisions for all kinds of sports and games.

reviews.review_heading: I am quite satisfied because of facility campus and environment of college etc.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure is quite decent. The hostel is well-furnished and clean. The mess food is tasty, healthy, and offers a nice menu. Hostel Wi-Fi has a good range, but campus Wi-Fi is comparatively slower. Overall, campus buildings are well-maintained, seating areas are good, and classrooms are suitable for learning.

reviews.review_heading: College didn't met the expectations I had before taking admission here.
reviews.review_text: There are many labs, 3 boys’ hostels, and 1 girls’ hostel. There are different departments. Hostels are clean, and every year hostel rooms are allocated based on the year of study. Clean water coolers are provided, but the water is still a bit dirty, so we need to take care of ourselves.

reviews.review_heading: Best Faculty, Better Placements and Excellent Cultural Committee and Extra Ciruculam Supporting .
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of GNDEC is excellent, though maintenance could be improved in some areas. The CS/IT labs are equipped with PCs featuring i5 processors (13th Gen). The college has more than a hundred computers and a server room. Additionally, there are well-equipped labs for ME, CE, and other departments.

reviews.review_heading: The college is one of the best college in Punjab for pursuing core branches.
reviews.review_text: The college has decent infrastructure and facilities, which are value for money. Wi-Fi is available throughout the campus. Hostels are pretty good, with attached washrooms in the first year, and the mess food is also good. The grounds and sports equipment are well-maintained, and the college excels in sports.

reviews.review_heading: The college faculty is very friendly. The environment of the college is very open.
reviews.review_text: The college has various labs, including hardware, DBMS, WD, OS, and PL labs, all of which are equipped with Wi-Fi and high-tech PCs. The classrooms are well maintained, although there are some hygiene issues due to a lack of proper soap facilities in the washrooms.

reviews.review_heading: Strong foundation, needs growth.
reviews.review_text: The college has good infrastructure, including Wi-Fi throughout the campus, air-conditioned labs with computers, clean classrooms with projector screens, a quiet and air-conditioned library, and good medical facilities. The hostel food is not that great, but the canteens are good. They also have games that are fabulous.

reviews.review_heading: Review of Guru Nanak Dev Engineering College.
reviews.review_text: The college infrastructure is quite good and above average. Infrastructure of labs and classrooms is quite good. Overall, campus is very well maintained. Courses are also quite good.

reviews.review_heading: Good placements in 2023. Budget-friendly college with a good facility in Bachelor and Masters course
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure is quite good. There is a proper department for the library. Hostel management is good. The quality of food is regularly inspected by a food inspector. Students are provided with IDs to access Wi-Fi. There are dedicated labs for each course with attendants to manage them. Classrooms are fully ventilated with smart projectors and have proper curtains. Hostel room is spacious. The management of mess is good. Good quality food is served to students. Hostel has wardens and rules need ...

reviews.review_heading: Highly recommended college.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure here is really good; we have our own departmental library. As I'm a day scholar so I've listened to other students, hostel life is really good here. We have labs for each and every subject, and all the required equipment is present. Students have their personal IDs to use the Wi-Fi on campus, and the speed of the Wi-Fi, I can say, is average on some phones, but on others, it's good!

reviews.review_heading: Guru Nanak Dev Engineering College.
reviews.review_text: The facilities and infrastructure of this college are very good and well-developed, including buildings, labs, classrooms, and more. One downside is that while technical colleges typically have technical classrooms, this college has manual boards and lacks speakers in classrooms. The hostel and canteen facilities are good.

individual_reviews.title: Strong academics, experienced faculty, green campus, placements, but limited industry exposure.

content.Placements: 60-70% placements with top recruiters, a decent average package, and strong internship opportunities. Good placement ratio with reputed companies, high package outliers, and solid internship exposure. The majority of students are placed with average packages, top recruiters visiting, and good internship support.
content.Infrastructure: BIET has a large green campus spread over 240 acres, one of the largest in UP. Wi-Fi/Internet is available across the campus and hostels with broadband connectivity for students and faculty. BIET provides separate hostels for boys and girls, with a combined capacity of around 1,500 students. There are facilities for volleyball, badminton, football, basketball, track events, and gym equipment.

individual_reviews.title: Not a satisfying feeling here, there is something lacking.

content.Placements: Top roles offered are quality engineer, software engineer, and system administrator. Top recruiters are like TCS, Byju's, Mahindra, Physics Wallah, etc. Median salary is around 6 LPA, and the highest package yet is 64 LPA. Students get placed for further studies.
content.Infrastructure: Mess food quality is not as good in the mess, students go outside for the meal. The canteen has some items available like burgers, eggs, milk, Maggi, rolls, etc. Wi-Fi is available all over the campus with moderate speed and within a definite range.

hostel_campus.college_name: BIET Jhansi Infrastructure Details & Reviews

reviews.review_heading: Strong academics, experienced faculty, green campus, placements, but limited industry exposure.
reviews.review_text: BIET has a large green campus spread over 240 acres, one of the largest in UP. Wi-Fi/Internet is available across the campus and hostels with broadband connectivity for students and faculty. BIET provides separate hostels for boys and girls, with a combined capacity of around 1,500 students. There are facilities for volleyball, badminton, football, basketball, track events, and gym equipment.

reviews.review_heading: Not a satisfying feeling here, there is something lacking.
reviews.review_text: Mess food quality is not as good in the mess, students go outside for the meal. The canteen has some items available like burgers, eggs, milk, Maggi, rolls, etc. Wi-Fi is available all over the campus with moderate speed and within a definite range.

reviews.review_heading: If you have other options, go for them and don't come to BIET.
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure is not as good as you'd expect, and hostels are just meh. The college is spread over 210 acres, but there are just 15-20 buildings at max, and they too are not properly built and lack a lot of basic facilities. Also, there are a lot of buses and stuff in the college here and there.

reviews.review_heading: Here, some courses lack their department buildings and proper faculty.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure is not up to expectations, as the area of the college is quite big, being 210 acres, but there are very few buildings here and there. As for hostels, there are a few hostels where 2 are for girls, and 7-8 are for boys, and they're not very good either.

reviews.review_heading: College has okayish academics, worse infrastructure, and even worse culture.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure for my course is not much as there's just a single building for civil engineering, and there are a number of hostels in our college, where 2 are for girls, and 7-8 are for boys. The infrastructure is not up to par, and only the main buildings are there, some important buildings are yet to be built.

reviews.review_heading: Moderate and decent package.
reviews.review_text: There are 11 hostels. Wi-Fi is available all over the campus, named BIET, with good speed. One common library for all the year students. One common sports ground for sports like football, cricket, kabaddi, and volleyball. One building for indoor games is available.

reviews.review_heading: Tier-3 doesn't do over expectation.
reviews.review_text: Facilities and infrastructure are available. Vrindawan hostel for first-year boys. Sake Bhawan for second-year boys. Panchavati Bhawan for third year boys, Jai Bharat Bhawan for fourth year boys. Yashodhara Bhawan and Kalpana Chawla for girls. Each hostel has its own mess and canteen facilities.

reviews.review_heading: BIET has decent past placement records that are quite impressive. ROI of college is decent.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure is quite old, but it's not that bad because the greenery present in the college makes the environment very lovely. Mess food is also not that bad, not as good as home, but it's okay.  24/7 Wi-Fi is available in the hostel, and campus sports facilities are also good, like a badminton wooden court, table tennis hall, gym, football, cricket ground, volleyball, track and field, and many more. The library is quite good for studying with an AC facility, and classrooms are basic gree...

reviews.review_heading: It is not good for placement.
reviews.review_text: Wi-Fi is present all over the campus named as BIET. It has good speed and unlimited access 24X7. One common library for all where all necessary and basic books are available for competition exams or for semester exams. All around canteen is present for our daily needs inside a hostel campus.

reviews.review_heading: It has strong labs and supportive faculty. There is scope for improvement in industry exposure.
reviews.review_text: The central library holds more than 40,000 books and journals, including digital resources and access to online journals. Students also have access to a departmental library for Civil Engineering references. A 24x7 medical facility is available through the college dispensary, staffed with a president's medical officer. For severe cases, students are referred to the nearby government or private hospital in Jhansi.

reviews.review_heading: Do not take admission in this college unless you have a necessity.
reviews.review_text: There is 1 hostel for first year boys (Vrindavan Hostel) with average infrastructure. For the 2nd year, there are 3 hostels (APJ, Rajendra, and Sake), they get allotted based on the marks (YGPA) of the first year. Mostly, the top 10-15 students get APJ (single-person/room, good infrastructure), most students get Rajendra (2-person/room, good infrastructure), and students with some poor marks get Sake (the worst infrastructure, always leaks, and is dirty). In the 3rd year, there are 2 hostels, an...

reviews.review_heading: Good for middle-class students as it feels affordable.
reviews.review_text: There are 11 hostels, 9 hostels for boys and 2 hostels for girls. Wi-Fi facilities are available all over the college campus and hostels. Classrooms are well arranged in separate blocks for different branches. A common library for all students and canteens are present in some hostels.

reviews.review_heading: Best for competitive exams.
reviews.review_text: There are 8 hostels for boys and 2 hostels for girls. All hostels and the college campus are well connected with Wi-Fi named BIET. Labs and classrooms are well organized, with very well-skilled laboratory teachers. One common library is available for all students. One common dispensary is also present.

reviews.review_heading: Average teaching, low fees and good placement result in high ROI, best for government exam aspirant
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure includes a community center, a multi-purpose hall (MPH - auditorium), a student activity center (SAC) with indoor games and gym area, a central playground (CPG) for outdoor games, and an academic block which is the main building where classes happen; it is sufficient, has all labs and workshops, and has departments for all courses, which is good overall. There is also an innovative and incubation center (IIC) building related to placement, a good central library, a guest house, 7-...

reviews.review_heading: It is the best college for higher studies and competition exam preparation.
reviews.review_text: Overall, the infrastructure of the college is old-fashioned. There are 11 hostels in BIET, Jhansi, in which all-year students live separately. Wi-Fi is provided all over the campus and hostel. The speed is not enough to depend on, as the area is also affected by the speed of the network.

content.Placements: The course has a 50-60% placement rate. The highest package ranges between 4 LPA - 5 LPA. The lowest salary is 2 LPA. The average salary is 4 LPA. individual_reviews.title: The college got both good and bad, but mostly bad.

individual_reviews.title: A fantastic college for Hospitality Management.

content.Placements: We've observed excellent placements in the past 5 years, and it's a good thing to have placements. The highest package is INR 16 LPA, and students are placed not only in India but in many other countries, but internships are not much available at this college.

individual_reviews.course: BBA in Tourism and Hospitality - Batch of 2024
individual_reviews.title: Nice infrastructure, good faculty and nice placements .

content.Placements: 95% of students are placed in our course. The highest package is Rs 55,000 per month, and the lowest package is Rs 25,000. The average package is Rs 41,000 per month. Top recruiting companies are Thomas Cook, ITC Hotels, Lemon Tree Hotel, The Oberoi Group, Westin, etc. 83% of students got an internship from our course. Roles offered are travel conductor, event manager, cabin crew, counter clerk, and sales manager.

The campus is spread over 16 acres in a beautiful atmosphere, and our college provides the best facilities. There are big classrooms and labs, a library, a separate field for sports, and the hostel is good because it provides all the basic facilities, like washing machines, mineral water, and a common gym. WIFI is available 24 hours a day, and the canteen food is delicious.

individual_reviews.course: BBA in Tourism and Hospitality - Batch of 2021
individual_reviews.title: The college is very spacious. We have a place for everything, and with supporting staff.

content.Placements: People who are interested in hospitality and tourism are placed in our course. The highest salary offered is Rs. 40,000 per month. The lowest salary offered is Rs. 5,000 per month. The average salary offered is Rs. 15,000 per month. Thomas Cook, Marriott, Taj, ITC, etc., were the top recruiting companies. Everyone got internships in various companies like By W Goa, Marriott, Taj, Kaakatiya and ITC etc.
content.Infrastructure: The college provides everything like labs, Wi-Fi, classrooms. There is a huge library, and we are improving and developing ourselves continuously. Teaching is based on technology like using projectors and Pdfs etc. We are even more active in social activities like campaigns etc.

individual_reviews.course: MBA in Tourism and Hospitality Management - Batch of 2018
individual_reviews.title: Dr. YSR National Institute of Tourism and Hospitality Management is good.

content.Placements: Our college is famous for tourism and hospitality. Our batch and our seniors got good placements and internships. Students got placements in many companies like Thomas Cook, SOTC, Cox & Kings, EBIX Travels, Rainbow Travels, and 5-star property hotels, and corporate events companies, etc. The job roles offered were sales and operations. individual_reviews.title: It is a request to all my young and energetic juniors, don't join this college.

reviews.review_heading: My journey in EEE at SRIT.
reviews.review_text: Wi-Fi in our campus is currently developing, as of now, there are few Wi-Fi spots around the campus, but they are developing now in full wing. The library needs to get upgraded, but sufficient books are definitely available in our library. The hostel is average as my friends stay there as they include ending machines which are currently installed. It has 24x7 water and electricity facilities guaranteed with above-average food.

reviews.review_heading: Good infrastructure but not that much good placements.
reviews.review_text: No wi-fi, classrooms are okay, not that good, libraries are okay, not worth the money, labs are not that good to work and there is no proper software to work. No wi-fi, no LAN connection to computer—everything is a waste of time and money.

reviews.review_heading: Strict rules and a stressful environment for the students. Student strength is less.
reviews.review_text: Poor signal, medical facilities are not easily accessible. Hostel food was below average until last year but I have no idea how it is today. The infrastructure is okay. Hostel buildings are old and they are in the middle of mountains, making them more susceptible to insects and animals .

reviews.review_heading: Good hostel facilities and well-qualified faculties. The tie-up is with Malaysian University.
reviews.review_text:
1. There is a good Wi-Fi connection in labs, hostels, and libraries. No Wi-Fi is available in classrooms. Classrooms are very spacious and comfortable.
2. Hostel facilities are much better than at other colleges in Coimbatore. Floors will be cleaned daily and sanitized properly.

reviews.review_heading: Our college provides average placements, infrastructure, and facilities.

Sports are conducted in this college.

reviews.review_heading: It is an excellent college for engineering.

reviews.review_heading: Our college provides good placements, and it has a good infrastructure.
reviews.review_text: Everything was fine. Wi-Fi should be improved. Classrooms were good. The library should be more spacious. They served very good food in the canteen and mess. Medical facilities were not good for hostel students. Medical facilities should be improved.

reviews.review_heading: It's a well reputed college in Coimbatore.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of the college is considered to be average when compared to other colleges in Coimbatore, but the campuses are clean and well maintained whereas the hostels are a bit average and old. The college is located in a rural area away from the city which makes the place very peaceful.

reviews.review_heading: Review of SRIT - Sri Ramakrishna Institute of Technology.
reviews.review_text: Wi-Fi is a little slow. The infrastructure is decent. There must be certain facilities that need to be provided in the hostel, like a television. There is no tower inside the hostel, which makes it difficult to take calls and use data services.

reviews.review_heading: Review of SRIT - Sri Ramakrishna Institute of Technology.
reviews.review_text: Laboratory and classrooms are average. Hostel facilities are also average. I would not recommend to join hostel.

reviews.review_heading: Review of Sri Ramakrishna Institute of Technology.
reviews.review_text: The hostel is neither good nor bad. Food is not good. The environment is good and the climate is better.

reviews.review_heading: It is the best college to study.
reviews.review_text: Our college has a good infrastructure to study well. All the lab equipment is available for practical implementation. Library in our college is good and has all the books relevant to academics.

reviews.review_heading: Review of Sri Ramakrishna Institute of Technology.
reviews.review_text: Classrooms are well-equipped with projectors and digital screens. There is a net lab, MBA lab, IT lab, CS lab, MAT lab, a lab, de lab, electrical machines lab, CAD lab, DSP lab, and more. Hostel rooms are spacious and each room is allotted for 3 students. Food served in the hostel is good. TV hall, gym, and recreation room are available in the hostel. Ambulance service is available and hospital services will be provided at Ramakrishna rural health care center.

reviews.review_heading: Our college has good placements and good teaching.
reviews.review_text: In our department, we have good Wi-Fi and good lab facilities. The library is very useful, and it has lots of books. There are medical facilities to take intensive care of students. Our college got a great contract for the food service, so we are well known for it. As our college was provided with a great environment for the field of sports, we are acquiring the best sports here.

reviews.review_heading: The scenery is good in our college.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure is decent and not extremely good. It is average for an engineering college but the atmosphere is excellent. Wi-Fi is available for all the departments and hostels. Classrooms are clean and spacious. Lab facilities are also decent. The food is not up to the mark but okay.

paragraphs: ICFAI University Jharkhand admission processis a multi-step process. Candidates can check the steps below:
STEP 1: Application Process
Candidates are required to apply online on the official website of the institute. Students can also download the form from the official website.

reviews.review_heading: A value for money college for law aspirants.
reviews.review_text: There is no hostel facility available; you can stay in PG as many places in that locality allow that. The infrastructure is not that good; there's one building with 3 floors (2+1); the parking is also very crowded, but the library has a variety of books ranging from all the best authors and publication houses. The library has seating available with good connectivity of Wi-Fi. The college provides Wi-Fi connectivity in all the places of the campus.

reviews.review_heading: Overall, a good choice for students.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure is not so good but the college is now in construction so we hope for the best. Other than that, there is Wi-Fi on our campus, a canteen,  3 computer labs and many more things for student comfort. The college does not own a hostel as of now.

reviews.review_heading: I am satisfied with this college.
reviews.review_text: Our college provides good facilities and infrastructure. Wi-Fi is available. Many books are available in the library. The hostel facilities are not available. A canteen is available. Sports and games facilities are not available.

reviews.review_heading: I am satisfied with the college because of its faculty members and learning.
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure is good, properly cleaned, and managed with chairs and desks. The college has different labs for every department with well-equipped advanced machines, and labs and arranges industrial visits on time. College organizes seminars and webinars for students' career development.

reviews.review_heading: Our university is the best.
reviews.review_text: College infrastructure is very well maintained with good care. Classrooms are well-equipped with smart classes, benches, and podiums.  We have a well-furnished library with all the latest books and journals. There are several labs for B.Tech.

reviews.review_heading: It gives a great learning experience and it has great infrastructure.
reviews.review_text: The college has a centrally air-conditioned and fully equipped auditorium with a seating capacity of over 750 people. The college takes pride in being a differently abled-friendly campus with new ramps. The college has various facilities to address the reading, hearing, and understanding requirements of multiple students. ICFAI has excellent classrooms and labs.

reviews.review_heading: The campus life at ICFAI University Jharkhand is good.
reviews.review_text: Our University has all the essential infrastructure that should be present in a University. We have a massive library with a good collection of books and journals, fully air-conditioned computer labs, smart classrooms, an auditorium, a badminton court, a moot court, etc.

reviews.review_heading: Our university is the best in Eastern Region.
reviews.review_text: Great campus life is not limited to good infrastructure or providing the students with a high-quality education. Focus has to be on the development of the students in various ways like effective teaching strategies, positive student-faculty relationships, and productive interactions with peers, seniors, and juniors. Wi-Fi, labs, classrooms, library, and canteen are good.

reviews.review_heading: The campus is not good in Ranchi.
reviews.review_text: The facilities and infrastructure are good, and all the classes are smart including Wi-Fi, computer, laboratories, classroom, and library except from physics and chemistry laboratories and workshop. There is no hostel facilities. The mess and canteen are not available in this college.

reviews.review_heading: 100% placement for students after completing the course.
reviews.review_text: In ICFAI University Jharkhand all the infrastructure facilities are available in college like transportation Wi-Fi best faculty members and an eco-friendly environment. Inside our campus, the university provides a canteen where we get to eat fresh food. When someone gets sick the university also provides first aid for this student and in serious cases faculty members and health, the student takes them to the hospital.

reviews.review_heading: I am satisfied and very happy with the university.
reviews.review_text: In our university, there are separate and big classrooms for every course. It has a library and also provides high-speed free Wi-Fi. There are two or more laboratories for every course. The university does not have hostel facilities, but students can get with the help of university volunteers, and these volunteers are ready to help students in every step. There is a big canteen in our university, and they are clean and hygienic. But our university doesn't provide sports clubs and games. Students...

reviews.review_heading: Many students get to pursue the course on 50% scholarships which is great.
reviews.review_text: In terms of infrastructure it is pretty decent not too good but the important ones like Wi-Fi, Labs & Workshops, Well Furnished Classrooms, Well stacked Library, computer labs are good here while campus is small which needs to improve. Canteen is available on campus. Hostel facility is not available on campus but it is available near its city office in PGs.

reviews.review_heading: Very dissatisfied with campus infrastructure and the university's poor vision for growth.
reviews.review_text: Campus is very small with no adequate classrooms. Facilities like Wi-Fi, Computer Labs, Canteen is available. No sports facilities available. Overall infrastructure is poor. The university authorities too are not interested in expanding campus and building up strong infrastructure.

reviews.review_heading: Students here can learn with fun.
reviews.review_text: The college has good lab facilities like computer lab, physics and chemistry labs with required apparatus. There is a well-organised library from where you can issue any book at any time. There is a well-managed and clean canteen with varieties of food, but there is no facility of the hostel.

reviews.review_heading: Review of The ICFAI University, Jharkhand.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of our college is good. We have been provided with all necessary facilities like a library with all essential learning materials, etc. There are classrooms with projectors, and the labs are well-equipped. Wi-Fi facility is also available here. Students who stay far away from our college have been provided with pick-up and drop facility. The canteen is available on the campus, but a sports centre is not available.

faqs.answer: Both are popular job roles, as per the World Economic Forum report. The key differences between the two are as follows:The Data Analyst collects relevant data from various sources to filter and analyze it. The data scientist gathers sizable amounts of structured and unstructured data while performing data mining.Education: To become a data analyst, you can apply with a Bachelor's degree in math, Statistics or a related field. Data scientists typically pursue a master's Diploma or degree in data Science.Salary: The salary of a data scientist is usually higher than that of a data analyst. According to global estimates, a data scientist can earn around $100,000 per year, whereas a data analyst can earn around $70,000.

review_summary.college_name: SRTMUN Nanded Reviews on Placements, Faculty & Facilities

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Information Technology - Batch of 2026
individual_reviews.title: Great infrastructure and learning but lacks management and placements.

content.Placements: Till date, only 20% of the students are placed, with the average package being 4 LPA. The placement is very low compared to previous years, and the companies that visit are not really great, mostly providing approximately 4 LPA. The only roles offered are as software engineers in campus placements.
content.Infrastructure: Infrastructure is at par, with hostels around average facilities. Wi-Fi is accessible everywhere on the campus, and the labs provide great student facilities. The quality of the food in the boys' hostel is not great, and campus food is better. The college's inclusion and motivation in sports is very good. Students also need to note that the hostel is based upon marks and admission category, and everyone might not get a hostel allotted. The other option is to live outside the campus in nearby PGs, and the experience is the worst.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2028
individual_reviews.title: Really good infrastructure, the worst faculty.

content.Placements: The average package is around 3 LPA, and the highest package is around 10 LPA, but only 25% of students get placed in the CSE department. Take admission in Information Technology or Automation and Robotics instead of CSE; you will get a lot of opportunities and qualified faculty compared to CSE.
content.Infrastructure: The infrastructure is too good. The hostel is good, and the quality of food is nice. The sports faculty is not working and has some personal issues. In sports, there is no crowd, and you will get free Wi-Fi to use. There are 10 labs in the CSE, so there is no problem; you will get many chances.

individual_reviews.course: Bachelor of Computer Applications (BCA) - Batch of 2026
individual_reviews.title: A decent choice for BCA students with good campus life.

content.Placements: Dnyanopasak College of Arts, Commerce, Science, and Technology provides decent placements. It supports students who are serious about building their careers. Around 20-30% of students from our batch get placed through campus drives. The average package offered is around 1.5-2 LPA, with the lowest package starting from 1 LPA and the highest package going up to 5-6 LPA depending on the course and company.
content.Infrastructure: College has a well-maintained campus with spacious classrooms. Along with computer labs, science labs, and Wi-Fi. A good library with sufficient academic books and journals. Laboratories are regularly updated. They are useful for practical learning. Campus environment is peaceful. It is suitable for studies.

individual_reviews.course: M.Sc. in Computer Science - Batch of 2025
individual_reviews.title: Tuition fee is affordable to pay.

content.Placements: Emerging companies like Elin Electronics, Keynes Technology, Optimus Electronics, and VVDN Technology from the side of electronics are major recruiting core companies mentioned in the records, alongside top MNCs like TCS, Infosys, and EY, which are a few of the companies with higher pay.
content.Infrastructure: The requests of students are taken into account immediately, but they provide solutions only after a long time by having frequent discussions about it. They are charging only a minimal tuition fee, as students from the native area, along with those from weaker sections, are applying.

individual_reviews.course: Bachelor of Pharmacy (B.Pharma.) - Batch of 2026
individual_reviews.title: Life and learning at Channabasweshwar Pharmacy College.

content.Placements: An average of 10 percent students are placed in the course. The highest package is 4 LPA, and the lowest is 2 LPA. Top recruiting companies for B Pharmacy are Cipla, Sun Pharma, and Dr. Reddy. Internship is provided by our college in Grinsaons Pharmaceutical Industry, Satara, and also at V Square, Mumbai. Posts like HR, clinical pharmacist, data analyst, and pharmacovigilance are the top roles. The placements in my college are decent but improving. Some pharmaceutical companies visit the campus for roles like medical representative, production trainee, quality control, and sales.

admission_process.title: SRTMUN Nanded Admission Process 2025

paragraphs: Admission toSRTMUN UG and PG coursesare both merit and entrance-based. Aspirants need to qualify for the minimum eligibility and qualify for the respective entrance exams for specific courses where it is needed. As per the next step, students need to fill out an online application form by visiting the official website of SRTMUN. Find below all the steps to get admission to SRTMUN:
STEP1: SRTMUN Application Process 2025
SRTMUN accepts an online mode of application process. Candidates seeking admission need to visit the official website of the university and apply online.
STEP 2: Selection Process

SRTMUN shortlists candidates based on state-level entrance exams, such as MAH B.Ed CET, MAH MBA CET, MHT CET, etc. for admission to specific courses. The university conducts Common Entrance Test (CET) for admission to programmes, such as BSc, MSc, etc. For all others, merit in the last qualifying exam is considered for admission. Besides, the university conducts an entrance test-PET for admission to PhD course. Candidates must score equal or aboveSRTMUN cutofffor admission.
STEP 3: Merit List and Counselling

The university releases a merit list to announce the names of the selected candidates. The merit list includes name of the shortlisted candidates, name of the college, obtained marks, etc. Aspirants appearing for Maharashtra entrance exams are offered seats through Common Admission Process (CAP). For others, aspirants need to come for university counselling. Shortlisted aspirants must pay the programme fee to confirm their seat in the university.

SRTMUN feeis sum of multiple components, out of which some are paid one-time while others are paid semester-wise. The components include tuition fee, caution deposit, hostel and mess charges, etc. The one-time fee isINR 30for each programme. The fee of SRTMUN is quite affordable for all the courses. faqs.question: How can I get a seat in SRTMUN?
faqs.answer: SRTMUN offer seats to candidates based on national/ state-level entrance exam or merit in the last qualifying exam. Aspirants are first required to register for the course of their choice via online mode. SRTMUN shortlists candidates based on state-level entrance exams such as MAH B.Ed CET, MAH MBA CET, MHT CET, etc. for admission to specific courses.The university conducts Common Entrance Test (CET) for admission to programmes such as BSc, MSc, etc. For all others, merit in the last qualifying exam is considered for admission. The university releases a merit list to announce the names of the selected candidates. Shortlisted aspirants must pay the programme fee to confirm their seat in the university.

faqs.question: Does SRTMUN conduct entrance exam?
faqs.answer: Yes, SRTMUN conducts an entrance exam for admission to PhD course. The university conducts PET in pen and paper mode at three centres, namely Nanded, Latur and Parbhani. The entrance test is conducted for two hours and includes section-A and section-B. Section-A is related to research methodology and includes 50 questions. Section-B is subject specific and includes 50 questions.

college_info.intro:
The flagship programmes offered at MPU University Bhopal are BSc, BTech, and MBA. The University provides these programmes to students at the UG and PG levels. Madhyanchal Professional University offers specialisations in Engineering and Technology, Medical and Paramedical Sciences, Agriculture Sciences and Technology, Education, Nursing, Sciences and IT, Management and Commerce, etc.
The University offers UG, PG and Diploma level programmes in full-time mode for the duration of 1 year to 4 years. The MPU University Bhopal admission process is through merit and entrance. MPU Bhopal courses strive to enhance the learning experience of students to prepare them for the industry. Admissions are currently open at MPU Bhopal. Candidates fulfilling the eligibility requirements can apply for admission. The university shortlists candidates for admission based on their score in the qualifying exam or entrance test. Below are the steps to get a seat in the university:
STEP 1: MPU Application Process 2025

Candidates are required to apply online on the official website of the institute. However, aspirants looking for offline applications must visit the campus. Aspirants have to pay an application fee to apply for admission.
STEP 2: Selection Rounds

The university shortlists candidates for admission based on their merit in the last qualifying exam for most of the courses. MPU accepts JEE Main for BTech and UGC-NET/ CSIR-NET/ SLET/ GATE for PhD admission. The university conducts MPUPET for selecting candidates for PhD programme. Once the entrance exam results are out, the university releases a merit list to announce the names of the selected candidates. Further, shortlisted aspirants need to report at the campus for document verification and fee payment.

reviews.review_text: We have a multistory building that contains 25 classrooms, 8 labs, 1 library, 4 staffrooms and a principal office. We have a large campus, a playground in beyond, and a canteen at walking distance. The college don't have a hostel so we have to stay at PGs or rental rooms, which is a major problem faced by students. The food in the canteen is outstanding, especially samosas; you will fall in love. The college has its own hospital with 40+ beds and environment is fabulous. We play pool games, badm...

reviews.review_heading:
Average college with worst management and worst placement rate this year.
Infrastructure is everage.
reviews.review_text: The labs are not good at all, and some computers in our lab do not even work. There is no hostel. The food in the canteen is pretty good, but the price is a little bit high. There is also a basketball court and a volleyball court. There is also a massive cricket field.

reviews.review_heading: Satisfied with the faculty members but dissatisfied by the colleges fake scenarios.
reviews.review_text: Excellent infrastructure; the canteen facility is excellent as well. There is a library, auditorium, temple, playground, and 7 buildings of 3 floors each. Overall, the infrastructure is satisfactory. The medical center is located in the nursing building. The auditorium is very large, with a minimum seating capacity of 100.

reviews.review_heading: The truth of the low-grade college.
reviews.review_text: The college in which I am studying is a low-grade college with poor infrastructure and very bad management. The computer lab is just for show. There is no Wi-Fi on the campus, the library is small, the books there are outdated and it was closed during exam time when we students needed it the most.

reviews.review_heading: I am absolutely dissatisfied because of faculty.
reviews.review_text: Wi-Fi is not available in this institution. Labs are available, so you can practice on a laptop or PC in the lab. The library is available. They give us books for 6 months. After that, we return to these books. We play volleyball, cricket, and kabaddi.

reviews.review_heading: It is a very good college, and you can go for it.
reviews.review_text: The labs and library are very good, but the classrooms are not good. Wi-Fi is not available on our campus. Food is affordable. Sports teams are available, and you can play any time. Medical facilities are available at any time.

reviews.review_heading: I am satisfied with placements of this college.

Hostel facilities and quality of food served are very nice. A canteen and medical facilities are available. Sports and games are available at our university.

reviews_list.review_title: I would not recommend joining this college.

review_content.Placements: To be honest with you sir/mam. Less than 50% of students got placed in my course. If we talk about the highest package it's around 1-2 LPA, the average package is around 1 LPA and the lowest package is Rs. 70,000 - Rs. 80,000. Top recruiters are TCS, Bebo, and Rubicon. Below 30% of students got internships. Top roles offered are engineering, data science, and cyber security.
review_content.Infrastructure: They don't even have Wi-Fi connections for each floor which makes it difficult to stay connected to Wi-Fi. Labs are decent not too good. Classrooms are good. The library is good, a place for students to study and work. Some of my friends are from the hostel. So they always talk about they give bad food, roti is very hard to eat, we are suffering here. If we look at the hostel building from the outside it will look fine but from the inside it's dirty, I'm not lying. The canteen is good there but they have expired food. Medical facilities are normal. Sports are good.

reviews_list.batch_info: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2027
reviews_list.review_title: Overall, the college review about placements, environment, college life, and facilities.

review_content.Placements: Around 40% of students got placed. The highest salary package offered is 6 LPA and the lowest salary package offered is 1 LPA. The average salary package offered ranges from 3-4 LPA. Top recruiting companies like TCS, Wipro, Accenture, Smart Data Enterprises, and Infosys visit the college for placements. The internship percentage in our college is about 30%, and most of the internships are unpaid. Top roles like software engineers and testers are offered to students.
review_content.Infrastructure: We have two grounds, one ground is big and the other is small. The library is well-facilitated and has Wi-Fi. There is a mess and canteen. Sports facilities are good but not up to the mark. Mess food quality is superb. It does not have medical facilities. We have a computer lab and a pharmacy lab.

reviews.review_heading: It's a top college for BCA with good placements.
reviews.review_text: Labs are good, especially the ones made in the law and MBA block. Hostels are also fine, and there is a book bank and library as well, with all the latest books. Washrooms in the old buildings are not that good, but in the new buildings they are fine. AC is not installed in old buildings, but there are centralised ones in the new building.

reviews.review_heading: It has supportive faculty and staff members.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of the main BCA building is old and does not seem well-maintained. The lift is slow, although there are only 4 floors. Our classes are often scheduled in the law block, which is full of facilities. Desktops are not functioning well, but in classrooms, projectors are good. Always cleanliness is maintained. Wi-Fi is slow. The canteen is good and pocket-friendly.

reviews.review_heading: Good faculty members, average placements. Pretty good infrastructure, not really good though.
reviews.review_text: Facilities and infrastructure are fabulous for our department, except that there's no network in the classroom. The computers in the labs are bare minimum. The library is very good, and there's Wi-Fi available. There are a lot of places, so no need to worry about finding space to sit, and there are also computers in the library (around 6-7 computers).

reviews.review_heading: Good placements are provided in this course in 2025.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure is quite good. Classrooms are better, but in some classrooms, there is no AC. The library is good because we can get many books on ethical hacking, cybersecurity, full-stack development, front-end, back-end, and app development. The system is also good. All-time internet is available. I am not in the hostel, so I cannot tell properly. The hostel is better. There is one canteen. Medical facilities are good. It also has a ground. Students can get a chance in sports like football...

reviews.review_heading: Overall good, providing a good environment for industry-ready jobs.
reviews.review_text: About 70% of students were placed and got internships. According to the latest data from the placement cell, the highest package for BCA is 24 LPA, and the average package is about 6-7 LPA. Top recruiters are TCS, Infosys, Wipro, Deloitte, SAP Labs, and Accenture. Reports come from the campus drive.

reviews.review_heading: Absolutely satisfied with the faculty, good placement in 2024, good infrastructure and facilities.
reviews.review_text: The labs are good and well-maintained. The Wi-Fi speed is good enough for the need. Classrooms are big enough and have proper seating arrangements. The library is big with lots of books, and u can issue any book from there for 15 days with your college ID for free.

reviews.review_heading: Completely satisfied because of the faculty.
reviews.review_text: The hostel provides facilities, cleanliness, and safety to the students who are traveling from a long distance, and it provides a home-like environment so that students do not feel homesick and can easily concentrate on their studies and practicals.

reviews.review_heading: Its a decent college just infrastructure needs to get better.
reviews.review_text: There is AC in labs and classrooms. Infrastructure of the college is good. Hostel infrastructure is not that good. Average quality and taste are provided in the mess. Canteen food is affordable and decent in taste. A sports facility is there.

reviews.review_heading: Only join if you want to relive school life, very bad campus life
reviews.review_text: The main building hasn’t been renovated for a long time. There’s no Wi-Fi or AC in classrooms (although available in computer labs). The rooms look exactly like school classrooms and don’t give a college aesthetic. The library is average. The canteen, especially after renovation, is lacking, half of the items are not available, and the food that is available is basic and not worth the money. You can get better food from the nearby C4e market.

reviews.review_heading: Good faculty, better placements than others.
reviews.review_text: Buildings are built nicely with air ventilation facilities and air conditioning, as well as a very good faculty. New law buildings are provided for second shift BBA course students so as to accommodate them and make them feel at home, which would be comfortable.

reviews.review_heading: Great campus life, decent faculty, and placement support can improve. Good infrastructure.
reviews.review_text: The college has good infrastructure with Wi-Fi-enabled classrooms, well-equipped labs, and a decent library. Classrooms are clean and spacious. The hostel facilities are average, but the canteen serves hygienic food. Sports facilities are available, and there's a medical room on campus for basic care.

reviews.review_heading: I am absolutely satisfied. It is good if one can work on their skills and build themselves.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of the college is decent as well. VIPS and Agrasen have better infrastructure, but I personally like the red brick wall. The computer lab is old-fashioned, but I think labs for B.Tech are better at MSIT. Sports department is also okay with a normal-size ground, but no coach or mentor. Few societies are nice on campus.

reviews.review_heading: The college has value for money and a good degree.
reviews.review_text: Classrooms are well-equipped with ACs and the library has a wide range of books related to the subject. Hostel facilities are very good. The classroom and surrounding areas are also very clean. Sports and games could also be played within the large playground.

reviews.review_heading: The college has good academics and a small campus.
reviews.review_text: The campus is clean and well-maintained, though it is not huge. Labs have decent setups with the most required software. Classrooms are spacious with projectors and whiteboards. The library is quiet and has AC. It is well stocked. Wi-Fi is available but limited mostly to labs and the library.

reviews.review_heading: It's an overall great experience.
reviews.review_text: The hostel is average, and the infrastructure is somewhat below average. There is no air conditioning, and there are significant issues with hygiene and the washrooms. However, if you can adjust with a bit of patience, you can make good friends and have a great experience. But as we say, there are always some hardships.

individual_reviews.course: Master of Computer Applications (MCA) - Batch of 2024
individual_reviews.title: My college from my perspective.

content.Placements: Talking about placement in Sanghvi Institute of Management and Science, placement is not provided by the college. You have to go outside to seek placement opportunities, like attending walk-in interviews, because the college doesn't assist with placements. Most importantly, the majority of students in the college are working individuals, so the college doesn't provide any placement assistance.
content.Infrastructure: No facilities are provided for the hostel. This means that from the college's side, no arrangements are made for accommodation, and you have to find outside accommodation such as rooms, paying guest accommodations, or hostels according to your comfort. Talking about the infrastructure of the college, it is very famous in Indore. The infrastructure of the college is good; it has a pool, a basketball complex, and a large playground area.

individual_reviews.course: Bachelor of Commerce (B.Com.) - Batch of 2024
individual_reviews.title: Placements are very bad of this college, no internship given to students.

content.Placements: In our college placement facilities are very poor. In our college very rare companies visit for campus selection. Feels are required for placement and internship opportunities. Students reach the companies out side from themselves for placement and internship. 10% students get placed in small firms, local companies. Average package offered 2LPA.
content.Infrastructure: Our college has good sports facilities, many sports competition and tournaments are organized by the college which helps to develop skills of students. Library with a lot of books, we can issue books with library card. Canteen facility are available where we enjoy tasty snacks and melodious tea. There is computer labs with good technology. Our classrooms are properly furnished with good benches and tables, light and fans, etc. Science labs is also available with good materials.

individual_reviews.course: Bachelor of Commerce (B.Com.) - Batch of 2024
individual_reviews.title: Our college has well-developed infrastructure.

content.Placements: Only a few students got placements in every stream. Placements are not good in our college. Students got placed in small companies and some local firms with the lowest salary package of 2 LPA - 3 LPA. Students have to pay for placement training. Around 10-30% of students got placed in our college.
content.Infrastructure: Our college provides good and well-developed infrastructure and facilities. Our college has Wi-Fi. All students and staff members can access Wi-Fi. Our college has a sports complex for students for playing and perform. There is a well-stocked library available in our college. It has many books which help students to prepare for competitive exams. Our college has a cafeteria which provides a variety of food items. Our college provides a gym to stay fit. Laboratories have all the required materials. Our college provides medical facilities which help in all kinds of emergencies.

individual_reviews.course: Bachelor of Commerce (B.Com.) - Batch of 2024
individual_reviews.title: It has good infrastructure and the best faculty, but the transportation facilities are not good.

content.Placements: There are not good placements in our college, but a few companies come here. Some students get placed in local companies and small firms. They offered an average salary package of 3 LPA. Field projects and internships are conducted, but not by the college. Students have to reach out to companies to get internships.
content.Infrastructure: The infrastructure is well developed. Many facilities are provided to students. There is a sports complex where many sports activities and competitions are held. faqs.question: Can I become a lawyer without a Law degree?
faqs.answer: No, you cannot become a lawyer without a Law degree.You mandatorily need to obtain degrees such as BA/BCom/BSc/BBA LLB or LLB in order to be a lawyer in India. Within two years of the enrolment, they must appear and clear AIBE in order to be eligible to practise anywhere in India.

faqs.question: Is there any job scope after doing BJMC course?
faqs.answer: A career in media industry requires commitment, dedication and sacrifice of personal time for the sake of staying on front or top, particularly in news industry. A journalist may have to work day in and day out to get breaking news. Similarly, media professionals who are in entertainment or film making need to work with passion which may come at the cost of their personal life. However, in a nutshell, Bachelor of Journalism and Mass Communication degree is enough for a person to fetch a job of any interest in the media field. admission_process.title: MIET Trichy Admission Process 2025

paragraphs: MIET Trichy admissionsare both merit and entrance-based. The college offers admission to its flagship programme i.e. BE/ BTech based on their qualifying exam scores. BTech aspirants have to participate in TNEA Counselling for admission. Besides,MIET Trichyoffers courses such as MBA and ME at the PG level. Admission to PG courses is based on national or state-level entrance exam scores. The college also offers a PhD at MIET in various specialisations. Candidates can reach out to the college via the enquiry form available on the college's website.

MIET offers AICTE-approved courses in affiliation withAnna University, Chennai. Aspirants must pass theGATE/CEETA PGfor ME andTANCETfor MBA. Candidates should also fulfil the eligibility requirements for their preferred course to get admission in the institute. Below are theMIET Trichy coursesalong with their eligibility and selection criteria:
Download:MIET Trichy Brochure

MIT Trichy admission 2025are currently open. Aspirants, after qualifying any of the accepted entrance test, can participate in the admission process of the college. Candidates must fulfil both the eligibility and selection criteria for admission. The college offers admission under both the Government and Management Quota. Aspirants seeking under Management Quota muct contact the college for detailed information. Below are the steps to get a seat in the college:
Step 1: MIT Trichy Application Process 2025

Aspirants in case of any query can raise their concern on the college's website. Candidates are required to first apply and appear for any of the accepted entrance tests. Once the candidates pass the entrance exam, they have to participate in the counselling rounds. Aspirants have to apply for TNEA after completing Class 12 for BE/ BTech.
Step 2: Selection

Candidates are selected based on their TNEA rank for BE/ BTech. For MBA and ME courses, aspirants have to pass TANCET and CEETA PG/ GATE, respectively. Aspirants with a valid score in these entrance test are offered a seat through counselling.
Step 3: Counselling & Seat Allotment

Aspirants are offered seat in BE/ BTech viaTNEA Counselling.For MBA and ME, aspirants are alloted seat in MIET viaTANCETandCEETA PG Counselling. For GATE-qualified candidates, a single-window counselling process will be conducted through the Common Engineering Admission Procedure (CEAP). Once the seat is alloted to the aspirant, he or she are required to report at the campus for MIET for document verification. Candidates also need to pay theMIET Trichy feeto confirm their seat.

courses_data.description: MIET Engineering College offers a two-year MBA programme at the PG level. The course is spread across four semesters. Admission to the MBA programme is based on the TANCET score of the aspirants.

faqs.question: What is the cutoff for MBA at MIET Engineering College?
faqs.answer: MIET Engineering College considers TANCET score for admission to MBA programme. Aspirants need to score equal or above the TANCET cutoff for admission. Below are the TANCET cutoff for MBA for past three-years:Section202220232024Overall654265046250

faqs.question: What is the eligibility for MBA at MIET Engineering College?
faqs.answer: Candidates who have passed graduation with a minimum of 50% aggregate are eligible to apply for MIET Engineering College MBA programme. There is a relaxation of 5% in the aggregate for BC /BCM /MBC /DNC /SC /SCA /ST. Such aspirants only required a minimum of 45% aggregate in graduation to apply for MBA. Besides, aspirants must also have a valid TANCET score for MBA admission.

faqs.question: What is the seat intake for MBA at MIET Engineering College?
faqs.answer: There are a total of 60 seats available in the MBA programme of MIET Engineering College. Aspirants are offered seats in MBA course based on the TANCET score of the aspirants. After passing TANCET, candidates need to participate in TANCET Counselling for seat allotment. Once selected, aspirants need to report at the college campus for document verification and fee payment.

faqs.question: Is there Management Quota at MIET Engineering College?
faqs.answer: Yes, MIET Engineering College offers admission through both government and management quota. Admission via Management Quota are conducted as per the norms set by the Government of Tamil Nadu and the Consortium of Self-Financing Colleges. Candidates must have a pass with minimum average marks in related subjects, including vocational theory and practicals combined to apply for admission under the Management Quota.

faqs.question: How can I get admission in MIET Engineering College?
faqs.answer: MIET Engineering College admissions are both merit and entrance-based. The college considers qualifying exam scores of the aspirants followed by TNEA rank for admission to BE/ BTech courses. Besides, the selection for MBA and ME courses is based on TANCET and GATE/ CEETA PG scores. Aspirants have to appear for respective entrance exam counselling for admission.

faqs.question: Can I join MIET Engineering College without TNEA?
faqs.answer: Candidates applying for BE/ BTech cannot get into MIET Engineering College without TNEA rank. Aspirants after completing Class 12 have to participate in the TNEA Counselling. The seats are alloted to aspirants based on their TNEA rank. Aspirants applying under the Management Quota do not require participate in TNEA. Such aspirants are offered direct admission.

faqs.question: Can I get MIET Engineering College through TANCET score?
faqs.answer: The answer to this question depends on the course applied by the candidate. In case of MBA, aspirants are offered admission based on their TANCET score. TANCET is an admission test conducted by Anna University once in a year. It is a state-level entrance exam conducted in offline mode for two hours. Talking about the TANCET score required for admission, The MIET TANCET cutoff for 2024 increased from 6542 in 2022,  6504 in 2023 to 6250 in 2024 indicates selective intake.

reviews.review_heading: The infrastructure is good.
reviews.review_text: Our course infrastructure is good and well-maintained. Our college has high-tech labs, and the hostel facilities are also good. For hostel students, they provide good food and ensure full security. Our hostel has a large seminar hall, and the canteen offers good food.

reviews.review_heading: Great campus and good placements.
reviews.review_text: Modern classrooms with smart boards, high-speed Wi-Fi, well-equipped labs, and a rich library. Hostels are clean with good amenities, mess food is hygienic with decent variety, medical center is 24/7, and ample sports/games facilities are available.

reviews.review_heading: I'm satisfied with our college.
reviews.review_text: The boys' hostel is average, and the mess is not bad. Girls' hostel is very best. The library has a 2.5 crore value of books and e-books. All labs have ACs and good personal computers. No medical facilities are available in my college.

reviews.review_heading: The college has good infrastructure and facilities.
reviews.review_text: Our college and my department have excellent infrastructure and facilities with available to latest labs and equipments with AC facilities and full-time Wi-Fi connections are required to gain extra knowledge by visiting the library. Our college hostel has the best infrastructure. They provide a lift for the student's comfort and a very quality of food is provided in mess and the canteen. They also conduct sports and games every week.

reviews.review_heading: It is a good college to study but not for enjoying the college days.
reviews.review_text: In our college, the infrastructure is not bad. All the time, the Wi-Fi will be on, there is no problem with that. Our labs are good and neat. It has fans, light, projector, etc. Our classrooms are always neat and clean. Library has been silent and the best place to gather about our course. I am not a hosteller so I don't know about that but canteen is not bad. Food and snacks are always available. Medical facilities are good in our college. Sports and games are only held on sports days.

reviews.review_heading: Really good infrastructure and facilities.
reviews.review_text: All facilities are available like Wi-Fi, labs, and library. Hostel is very good. Quality and availability of food are very nice. Emergency medical facilities are there and it is good. They will support sports and games and also available many sports activities at my college.

reviews.review_heading: Good infrastructure and knowledge development.
reviews.review_text: Wi-Fi connection is always available. Library has the excellent maintenance for the book section, and its easy to take the books from the library. Hostel facility is so good, and food is very delicious and healthy for maintenance. The canteen is so perfect.

reviews.review_heading: Facilities and infrastructure are good.
reviews.review_text: Facilities are very good and friendly. Infrastructure is good. Hostel food quality is nice and important for sports and games. The facilities in hostel and quality of food in mess and canteen are good. The facilities and infrastructure are very good and efficient. Medical facilities are good. AC is available for students.

reviews.review_heading: Really good infrastructure and facilities.
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure is very good. High facilities are available in my course. Classrooms are very comfortable with smart class technology. Wi-Fi is good. Labs are very maintained and library is very good. Hostel is very good with all facilities.

reviews.review_heading: Well-equipped campus with strong placements.
reviews.review_text: It has newly equipped wireless communication laboratory. The facilities and infrastructure for my course and department are well-equipped and maintained. The classrooms are spacious and have modern teaching aids like projects and smart boards. The department has all the accessories.

reviews.review_heading: Balanced campus life with skilled faculty members, solid infrastructure and excellent placements.
reviews.review_text: The campus offers steady Wi-Fi, modern labs, smart classrooms, and a well-stocked library. Hostels are decent with clean rooms, 24X7 water, and average-quality food in the mess. Sports courts, a health center, a gym, and recreational zones are also available, making student life balanced.

reviews.review_heading: Good enough for the students who are trying to study in a friendly environment.
reviews.review_text: The college offers well-equipped labs, smart classrooms, and a resourceful library. Hostels are better with basic amenities, good security, and average food. Sports spaces support a comfortable and productive student life. I recommend the hostel at 45%. That's all.

reviews.review_heading: Great infrastructure and faculty but placement support needs improvement.
reviews.review_text: The food in the hostel is hygienic and offers a decent variety, with both vegetarian and non-vegetarian options. Hostel rooms are clean and well maintained. Wi-Fi is available 24/7 and there are good study areas, medical facilities and indoor sports options. The classrooms are spacious, with projectors and labs that are well-equipped. The library is well-stocked and open during extended hours.

reviews.review_heading: M. I. E. T. Engineering has good infrastructure. Our surroundings have a green appearance.
reviews.review_text: We have a good and healthy environment. Our lab has a perfect network connection, and our staff explains the program clearly and understandably. The classroom is equipped with a nice board, fans, lights, and smart screens. We have a pleasant surroundings around our classroom.

reviews.review_heading: This college is absolutely good enough for the students who want friendly nature.
reviews.review_text: The hostel is quite average. The food provided in the hostel is good. The facilities provided by the management for the hostel are worth the money. The college offers well-equipped labs, smart classrooms, and a resourceful library, and its hostels are better with good amenities.

individual_reviews.course: Master of Business Administration (MBA) - Batch of 2015
individual_reviews.title: I satisfied with the college and faculty, but the placements are not good.

content.Placements: The college doesn't provide any placement opportunities. Not even a single company visit the college for placements. This is the reason why the students are choosing different occupations. Some people want to do business, and some students opt for government jobs. In 2015, not even a single IT company visited our college for placements.
content.Infrastructure: The campus looks very good. The staff members and the canteen are good. The furniture in the college is excellent. But the strength of this college is low. There were only 24 students in our batch, and there were only 76 students in our senior batch. Students maintain silence in the library. The campus is well-maintained. The playground is good.

individual_reviews.course: Master of Business Administration (MBA) - Batch of 2025
individual_reviews.title: Best college for workers.

content.Placements: The college has only MBA. The size of the class is 60 to 120. The college offers no placements. The college used to have placements but the placements stopped a few years ago. The college is best for people who are already in a job and want to pursue MBA.
content.Infrastructure: The college is well maintained and many classrooms. It has a computer lab Digital lab library and Rooms to rest or take a break. It also has the best infrastructure a garden and a fountain in the middle which makes the college look beautiful and also refreshing for students.
